about: Daylight saving time per region for kernel/clock.py (dst_active, wall; TIER1_SWEEP 11.1). Transitions are given in local STANDARD time, the clock the simulator keeps (state time_s counts standard-time seconds): the wall clock reads offset_h later from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive). A transition day is the nth weekday of a month (nth 1..5, or -1 for the last). null: the region keeps standard time all year.

us.source: Energy Policy Act of 2005, s. 110 (15 U.S.C. 260a): second Sunday of March 02:00 to first Sunday of November 02:00 local time (01:00 standard)

ca.source: Ontario Time Act (R.S.O. 1990, c. T.9), following the United States dates: second Sunday of March 02:00 to first Sunday of November 02:00 local time (01:00 standard)

uk.source: Summer Time Act 1972 and Summer Time Order 2002 (EU Directive 2000/84/EC dates): last Sunday of March to last Sunday of October, 01:00 UTC (01:00 GMT)

eu.source: Directive 2000/84/EC (Germany: Zeitgesetz): last Sunday of March to last Sunday of October, 01:00 UTC (02:00 CET standard time)
